# **E \- Development Tools and Process Setup**

**Performed by:** Phan Thi Thanh Huyen

**Reviewed by:** Nguyễn Công Kiên

 

**E.1 Development Process (Scrum)**

Our team follows the Scrum process for the whole project. Each Project Assignment (PA) is one Sprint of about 2-3 weeks. Every Sprint contains four meetings:

| Meeting | Count per Sprint | Purpose |
| :---- | :---- | :---- |
| Sprint Planning | 1 | Select work for the Sprint, create and assign Jira tasks |
| Scrum Meeting | 2 (spread across the Sprint) | Share progress, raise blockers, adjust plans |
| Sprint Review | 1 | Review what was delivered and what to improve |

Meeting notes follow the format in the "WeeklyReports" document and are stored in /docs/management/.

 

| Role | Member | Responsibility |
| :---- | :---- | :---- |
| Scrum Master | Gia | Organizes meetings, removes blockers, keeps Jira up to date |
| Product Owner | Gia | Prioritizes the backlog and clarifies requirements |
| Developers | All members | Everyone contributes to the source code |

**E.3 Task Management with Jira**

We created one project, with a Scrum board. All team members have been invited.

**Board workflow**

**Task rules we follow**

1. Every project task is logged: coding, report writing, design, testing, and self-training.  
2. Each task is assigned to exactly one member. If work is shared, we split it into separate tasks.  
3. Each task records a creation date, an assignment date, and a completion date. Creation and assignment may be the same day (e.g., during Sprint Planning).  
4. Tasks are created and assigned before work starts and moved to *Done* only when the work is actually finished. We never create, assign, and close a task in one go after the fact.  
5. Screenshots of all tasks are pasted into each weekly report.

### **E.4 Git Repositories**

* **Platform:** GitHub  
* **Access Control:** Private (TAs/instructors will request access when needed)  
* **Repositories:**  
  * **Frontend:** [https\://github.com/Adiff-git/Frontend-SWE](https://github.com/Adiff-git/AI-SWE) – Web client / User interface application  
  * **Backend:** [https\://github.com/Adiff-git/Backend-SWE](https://github.com/Adiff-git/AI-SWE) – Core business logic, database migrations, and REST/GraphQL APIs  
  * **AI Service:** [https\://github.com/Adiff-git/AI-SWE](https://github.com/Adiff-git/AI-SWE) – Machine learning pipelines, model artifacts, inference APIs, and data preprocessing scripts

**Working conventions**

* **Branching:** main is protected; work happens in feature/\<short-name\> branches and is merged by pull request after at least one review.  
* **Commit messages:** short and descriptive, in the form type: summary.  
* **Security:** API keys, secrets, and credentials are never committed. Secrets stay in .env files listed in .gitignore; only .env.example is tracked.

**E.5 Spec Kit**

We will adopt specification-driven development using **Spec Kit** to manage the workflow from specification to implementation. Setup and initialization are required from PA2, so in PA1 we have only read the introductory material and agreed to install it at the start of Sprint 2\. We will follow the detailed instructions provided by the instructors.

 

**E.6 AI Coding Accounts**

Every member has registered for a free educational account on an AI coding platform.

AI tools assist us, but every member must understand and be able to explain the code and documents they submit. AI-generated output is always reviewed by a teammate before merging.
